name: ANAC RBAC 91.151(b) VFR helicopter reserve (20 min)
cite: RBAC no 91, sec. 91.151(b) (EMD 00 full text, pinned rbac91-emd00.pdf; current emenda 07, 2026-01-19, pinned rbac91-emd07.pdf): 'Somente é permitido começar um voo VFR em um helicóptero se ... houver combustível e óleo suficiente para voar até o local previsto para primeiro pouso e, assumindo consumo normal de cruzeiro, voar mais, pelo menos, 20 minutos.'
condition_note: the Brazilian jurisdiction rule for the SP city pack — arithmetically identical to the FAA SFAR 20-minute helicopter tier (20 min at normal cruise consumption), separately cited from ANAC's own text; applied to eVTOL missions as the helicopter-tier analog the audited aircraft intend to operate under, stated as such
